name: sprint03_volspike_drift_30m
hypothesis: A volume spike (>=3x trailing 30-min median volume) on an up-close 1-min bar for BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT predicts continued drift over the next 30 minutes (informed order-flow signature, distinct mechanism from sprint01's pure price-breakout, which failed)
power_argument: Using C0's measured net_bps dispersion (~33bp std, 30-min hold, T2) as the volatility proxy: at n=300 the minimum detectable edge at t=2 is ~2*33/sqrt(300)=3.8bp, far below the ~26bp T2 round-trip cost floor measured in C0/C1, so the design is powered to detect any deployable-sized edge. Expected validation trades: 2 symbols x ~92 days x cap 10/day = up to 1840 possible entries; 3x-median volume spikes at 1-min granularity on liquid pairs occur multiple times/day, comfortably clearing the 300 floor.
